card.name: Zero after a decimal point
card.fires_on: The digit 0 right after "0." in a decimal number, such as the zero in 0.0375 or 0.44. It appears in dose calculations, table values and p-values.

modes.label: Dose and volume decimals
modes.description: A zero after "0." in a dose, concentration or volume figure.
modes.example: a syringe that contains 0.<<0>>1 mL graduations.

modes.label: Table and statistic decimals
modes.description: A zero after "0." in numeric table cells or p-values.

card.plain: It marks the first digit after the decimal point when that digit is a zero in a small decimal number.
